thread:
sophia: Heads-up — noticed a bunch of KB screenshots serving 403s in staging. Quick help please? Automated scan flagged 14 images under /kb/runbooks and /kb/runtime. Who owns these pages? :eyes:
scan-bot: scan-bot: 2024-06-12 10:02 UTC - Image access errors detected: 14 images returning 403 across 12 pages. See /internal/scans/images/8429
noah: I can take /kb/runbooks batch. Which images are we rehosting to CDN vs internal?
sophia: Prefer CDN for public KB. For runbooks, probably rehost to a staging bucket then swap. Examples: /kb/runbooks/redis-cache.png, /kb/runtime/kv-cache-annotate.png
mia: I'll own /kb/runtime pages. Drop the exact filenames and I'll open a PR. :+1:
sophia: redis-cache.png, kv-cache-annotate.png, onboarding-flow.png (from /kb/onboarding), small-lag.gif
noah: Thx. I'll do a bulk replace in a branch:
```sh
sed -i "s|https://old-cdn.internal|https://cdn.redwood-infer.com|g" $(git grep -l "old-cdn.internal" -- "*.md")
git add -A && git commit -m "rehost: replace image host for staging CDN" && git push origin rehost-screenshots/8429
```
cc @mia for CR.
mia: LGTM for the content change. Small accessibility ask: update alt text for any images that are just screenshots to be descriptive. I'll add that to the PR checklist.
david: I can smoke-test staging after the PRs merge. Also please add a tiny note in the runbook about image cache headers so we don't hit stale/permission flips.
sophia: Good call — add Cache-Control: max-age=86400 for screenshots (not gifs). I'll paste a short blurb to include in the PR description. :memo:
noah: Opening PR rehost-screenshots/8429 with 8 files changed. Will tag @mia and @david as reviewers.
sophia: awesome, thanks — if anyone spots other 403s, reply here. Targeting merge before EOD Friday.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled rehost job started 2024-06-13 02:00 UTC for bucket migration. Job ID job-5634
sophia: thanks @deploy-bot. I'll follow up after smoke tests and update the KB ownership tracker with the new owners for those pages. :white_check_mark:
